name: Usage Reporter
description: Reports AnythingLLM usage statistics — message counts, token usage, model activity, and system configuration across all workspaces. IMPORTANT: Always display the tool result exactly as returned, inside a code block, without reformatting or summarizing.
author: saulcutter

examples.prompt: How many messages have I sent in the last hour?
Show me my usage stats for the last 24 hours.
Give me a full usage report for the past week.
Show my system configuration and instance info.
What models have I been using this week?
How many tokens have I used today?
Show me my AnythingLLM system stats.

input.hint: Your AnythingLLM API key. Go to Settings → API Keys → Generate New API Key, then paste it here.
Base URL of your AnythingLLM instance. Default is correct for local Docker installs on port 3001.

timeframe.description: The time period to analyze. Options: 1h (last hour), 24h (last 24 hours), 7d (past 7 days), system (instance configuration and model info). Always display the returned report verbatim in a code block.
